top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Recognizes Right to be Free from Adverse Climate Change Impacts
top_5_upsc_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court of India expanded the scope of Articles 21 (Right to Life) and 14 (Right to Equality) to include the right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change, emphasizing the state's duty to balance biodiversity protection with renewable energy expansion.
key_points: Links environmental rights directly to fundamental constitutional rights.
Highlights challenges in protecting endangered species (e.g., Great Indian Bustard) versus establishing solar power infrastructure.
Sets a precedent for climate litigation and policy alignment in India.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
top_5_upsc_current_affairs.summary: India signed the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) nations (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland), securing $100 billion in investment commitments over 15 years.
key_points: First trade agreement for India with a commitment to target-based investment and job creation.
Reduces tariffs on high-end manufactured goods, precision instruments, and machinery.
Provides enhanced market access for Indian service sectors like IT, audio-visual, and professional services.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Pilot Projects for Green Hydrogen Usage in the Steel and Transport Sectors
top_5_upsc_current_affairs.summary: Under the National Green Hydrogen Mission, the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launched guidelines for implementing pilot projects using Green Hydrogen in the steelmaking process and heavy-duty transport.
key_points: Aims to reduce carbon intensity in hard-to-abate industrial sectors.
Supports decarbonization targets ahead of India's 2070 Net-Zero goal.
Fosters domestic technology development and reduces reliance on imported coking coal.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: UN Summit of the Future and the Adoption of the 'Pact for the Future'
top_5_upsc_current_affairs.summary: World leaders adopted the 'Pact for the Future' at the United Nations, focusing on multilateralism reform, international peace and security, digital cooperation, and global financial architecture reform.
key_points: Reiterates the urgency of reforming the UN Security Council to reflect contemporary geopolitical realities.
Includes a Global Digital Compact to regulate AI and bridge the global digital divide.
Emphasizes sustainable development funding mechanisms for the Global South.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) Recommendations on MSP Reform
top_5_upsc_current_affairs.summary: The CACP submitted policy recommendations highlighting the need for legal guarantees on Minimum Support Price (MSP), diversification towards climate-resilient pulses and oilseeds, and modernization of agricultural market infrastructure (e-NAM).
key_points: Focuses on crop diversification away from water-intensive wheat-paddy monoculture.
Addresses the economic sustainability of small and marginal farmers.
Examines procurement challenges and price stabilization mechanisms across states.
